| --- | --- | ---: |
| `@dsh-toolbox/product-research-workbench"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"` | Import URL or text evidence, organize findings, evaluate opportunities, back up projects, and ge"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nerate Markdown/HTML reports. | 12 |
| `@dsh-toolbox/context-switchboard` | Route tasks into bounded"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" contexts, activate native runtime context, and support rollback. | 10 |
| `@dsh-toolbox/plugin-pref"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"light` | Inspect local Bundles before installation for package semantics, capabilities, policy, SBOM"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" data, and fingerprints. | 2 |
| `@dsh-toolbox/compatibility-radar` | Discover Bundles, compare them"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" with a target runtime, save and compare snapshots, and generate upgrade reports. | 7 |
| `@dsh-tool"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"box/dsh-switchboard` | Discover DSH Profiles, inspect Bundles, plan and validate changes, create bac"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"kups and reports, and roll back safely. | CLI / control plane |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The first four components are independently installable DSH Profile Bundles.
